# Steamworks functions with hand-written stubs in steam_overrides.c.
# Each returns a value that gates boot progress (Init/IsSteamRunning must be
# true or Celeste aborts 'Steam not found!'), a string the wrapper reads
# (language/name/IP country), a specific ID (SteamID/AppID), or has a
# struct-by-value return (Controller data) that a generated stub cannot
# express. Every other implmap entry gets a generated default stub
# (bool true, fake non-NULL pointer, numeric 0). One name per line; must
# match the native name in steamworks.implmap exactly.
